An Apple Books Classic edition.

Marcus Aurelius’ Meditations is a Roman emperor’s private journal full of eye-opening thoughts on how to live with integrity and how to find peace in a world of chaos.

Written during his military campaigns in the second century, these reflections reveal a man at the height of his power, reminding himself that external success is fleeting and that the only true control we have is over our own responses. Throughout the book, Aurelius wrestles with mortality and duty, offering himself guidance on handling difficult people and staying grounded when the world demands too much.

Intimate and unsparing, Meditations is a compelling and accessible example of how Stoic philosophy can be a daily practice, not just an abstract idea.
